On 6 November 2026, ATHENA Intelligence refreshed more slowly than usual. Some pages and translations showed older stories for several hours while we worked on improvements to speed and reliability. No data was lost and no one's information was affected.

The service is now back to its normal rhythm, and we are moving to a faster, more resilient hosting setup so this does not happen again. We are grateful for your patience and for reading ATHENA.

The ATHENA Intelligence team
